{{Top|leg}}
'''Regional Director''' was a title given to a leader of a region. The [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] employed Regional Directors that answered directly to [[Territorial Administrator]]s.<ref name="CSA">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] also employed Regional Directors, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Hazar Yupcavage]] of the [[Imperial Corrections Service]] was one such director.<ref name="Purge">''[[Death Troopers: Recovered Messages from Purge]]''</ref>
